heading: Opposition to assistance by international financial institutions to terrorist states

tree.heading: In general
tree.text: The Secretary of the Treasury shall instruct the United States executive director of each international financial institution to use the voice and vote of the United States to oppose any loan or other use of the funds of the respective institution to or for a country for which the Secretary of State has made a determination under section 4605(j) 1 of title 50 or section 2371 of this title.

tree.heading: “International financial institution” defined
tree.text: For purposes of this section, the term “international financial institution” includes—

children.text: the International Bank for Reconstruction and Development, the International Development Association, and the International Monetary Fund;
wherever applicable, the Inter-American Bank, the Asian Development Bank, the European Bank for Reconstruction and Development, the African Development Bank, and the African Development Fund; and
any similar institution established after April 24, 1996.

notes.heading: References in Text
notes.text: Section 4605(j) of title 50, referred to in subsec. (a), was repealed by Pub. L. 115–232, div. A, title XVII, § 1766(a), Aug. 13, 2018, 132 Stat. 2232.

notes.heading: Codification
notes.text: Another section 1621 of Pub. L. 95–118 is classified to section 262p–4p of this title.

notes.heading: Similar Provisions
notes.text: Similar provisions are contained in section 262p–11 of this title.

notes.heading: Definitions
notes.text: The definitions in section 262p–5 of this title apply to this section.
